sql: select r.status, r.passed, r.failed, r.errors, r.cost_usd, (select string_agg(x.scenario_key || '=' || x.status || coalesce('[' || (select string_agg((c->>'id') || ': ' || left(c->>'note', 260), ' / ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') || ']', '') || coalesce(' ERR:' || left(x.error, 80), ''), ' | ' order by x.status) from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = r.id and x.status <> 'passed') as falhas from public.ai_sim_runs r where r.id = 'cf7f1316-07b3-4fb6-8075-4eeda0d3e3b3'
